title: Generative AI for urban planning: synthesizing land-use maps with satellite imagery via DualControlNet
abstract: arXiv:2611.05859v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Various land-use models characterize land-use patterns and facilitate scenario planning. However, existing models are largely predictive, forecasting transitions based on numeric data without synthesizing new land-use maps from simple text prompts. Meanwhile, generative AI in urban systems remains unimodal, weakly controllable, and evaluated mostly by generic image quality rather than domain-specific metrics. To address these gaps, we introduce DualControlNet, a generative land-use model that jointly synthesizes high-resolution land-use maps and satellite imagery, addressing multimodality, controllability, and verification challenges. Trained on over 40,000 paired tiles from Orlando and Chicago, DualControlNet is evaluated using land-use, spatial consistency, and image quality metrics. translated_title: 面向城市规划的生成式人工智能：利用DualControlNet合成土地利用地图与卫星影像
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.05859v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：各类土地利用模型可用于刻画土地利用模式并支持情景规划。然而，现有模型大多是预测性的，仅基于数值数据预测土地利用转变，无法通过简单的文本提示合成新的土地利用地图。与此同时，城市系统中的生成式人工智能仍是单模态的、可控性较弱，且多以通用图像质量而非领域特定指标进行评估。为填补这些空白，我们提出了DualControlNet，一种生成式土地利用模型，可联合合成高分辨率土地利用地图与卫星影像，从而应对多模态、可控性和可验证性的挑战。该模型在来自奥兰多和芝加哥的超过40,000对瓦片影像上训练，并采用土地利用、空间一致性和图像质量等指标进行评估。相对于单模态基线，DualControlNet将土地利用多样性一致性提升了62.8%，建筑覆盖率一致性提升了16.3%，更……
tldr: 本文提出DualControlNet，一种能根据文本提示联合生成高分辨率土地利用地图与卫星影像的双控制生成式模型，相比单模态基线将土地利用多样性一致性提升62.8%、建筑覆盖率一致性提升16.3%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DualControlNet, a generative land-use model that jointly synthesizes high-resolution land-use maps and satellite imagery from text prompts, improving land-use diversity consistency by 62.8% and building coverage ratio consistency by 16.3% over unimodal baselines.
